Senses.Explanation: An award made under an explicit condition in an address or case appraisal. One retained address promises half an eye to anyone who can judge whether an unnamed questioner understood the final saying. Another promises it to those who understand the character drawn with his staff; other witnesses attach the award to distinguishing two alternatives.
